Label downloaded SurveyCTO data

sctofactorgen.Rmd

Download your Excel form definition from the Design tab and a CSV export with raw choice codes from the Export tab of your SurveyCTO server. Use the form version that corresponds to the data. No API subscription or credentials are needed by the following local workflow.

library(sctofactorgen)
form <- scto_read_form("questionnaire.xlsx")
data <- scto_read_csv("responses.csv")
fields <- read_questions(form)
choices <- read_choices(form)
data <- singsel_label(data, fields)
data <- singsel_asfactor(data, fields, choices)
data <- multisel_label(data, fields, choices)
data <- multisel_levels(data, fields, choices, na_value = "zero")

Single selects become factors in form choice order. Unknown codes produce an error so mismatched form versions do not silently discard responses. Multiselects require expanded columns named question_code. The zero mode replaces missing indicators with zero; boolean returns logical indicators; NA preserves missing indicators. Choose the mode deliberately: a missing indicator can reflect a skipped question as well as an unselected option. Unexpanded space-separated responses are left unchanged.

Only single-language label columns and non-repeating fields are currently supported. External choice lists and dynamic choice lists are not resolved.

API downloads remain optional for accounts that have access. Install rsurveycto separately and pass authentication explicitly:

auth <- rsurveycto::scto_auth("/path/outside/the/repository/auth_details")
form <- scto_form("form_id", auth)
data <- scto_responses("form_id", auth)

Keep credentials outside the package and source repository. Automated tests use synthetic data and make no server requests.
